issues.text: Stock page includes a generic English 'Items' table (Invoice 1042, Purchase order, In progress, Add item, Edit/Delete) that clashes with the French robot workshop UI and uses a different style.
The placeholder-like 'Items / 57 items' block with 'Invoice 1042' and 'Quality check' data has nothing to do with robot stock, so it breaks domain realism.
On #/robots the robot cards are very tall, with five long bars per card, so the page needs much scrolling. Content is narrow and centered, leaving wide empty margins at 1440.
Much of the text is very small and light grey (card sublabels, filter chips, stat captions, 'Minimum' lines), so it is hard to read.

On #/robots the R-03 Hexa card breaks the layout of the others: the status pill, ring and badge are stacked, and the card is taller. Progress bar colors are inconsistent (R-04 Chassis is blue, others are orange or red). Energie and Capteurs bars look empty at 1280.
Score ring values differ between viewports (R-06 shows 5 at 1280 and 4 at 1440; R-05 shows 14 and 10), so the key numbers look unreliable. The average score of 45 does not match the cards' rings.

critic.summary: The French robot workshop UI is coherent and mostly realistic, but the Stock page has a foreign English 'Items' table and the robot cards are tall and use small, low-contrast text. Score values are inconsistent between the two viewports, so it fails.
